title: The Witcher 3 Remastered breaks Steam player records and arrives free for all versions
summary: The free next-gen update pushes CD Projekt's RPG to its all-time concurrent peak eleven years after launch.

title: Controversy on PC over Ace Combat 8 pre-order bonus: classic campaign not standalone
summary: Steam players criticize that the re-release of Ace Combat 7: Belkan War comes tied to the new game, while on consoles it is separate.

title: Rockstar reveals new GTA 6 details: over 170 animal species, hurricanes, and no Disney parody
summary: The game will include massive wildlife and dynamic weather, but Rockstar's owner confirms there will be no advertising or mockery of Disney World.

title: Sony limits PS5 Pro sales in Japan to active users to combat scalping
summary: Console scarcity forces implementation of a lottery system and play history verification.

title: Deadlock receives massive update with 6 new heroes, 10,000 voice lines, and Halloween aesthetic
summary: Valve's hero shooter hits all-time player peak after adding Rat King and revamping the city.

title: Valve replaces Steam sale events with personalized algorithm
summary: The front page will stop showing global discounts to recommend promotions based on each user's history.

title: Xbox launches 'Mythic Achievements' to show proximity to 100% in each game
summary: The new system, already in Insider phase, breaks down progress of the most difficult achievements as a response to PlayStation's Platinum Trophies.

title: Xbox launches its program to digitize physical games in all regions
summary: Players can convert their Xbox One and Xbox 360 discs into free digital licenses.

title: Satisfactory announces first expansion 'Core Values' with new beltless transport mechanic
summary: The underground factory introduces pipes and trains to move resources, radically changing logistics.

title: Minecraft Dungeons 2 now available: fast travel guide and cooperative improvements
summary: The sequel to the cooperative action-RPG arrives with new mechanics and maintains the original's accessibility.

title: GTA 5 mod for Switch cancelled days before launch after Take-Two pressure
summary: The developer thanks Rockstar's parent company for 'mercy' and shuts down the unofficial port project.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate surpasses 1.5 million copies sold
summary: The Ninja Turtles roguelike reveals its most played characters and celebrates the commercial milestone.

title: Naughty Dog confirms two new The Last of Us projects, but won't show Intergalactic until 2027
summary: The studio works on more saga content while its new sci-fi IP remains under wraps.

title: Star Fox receives 1.2.0 update with full patch notes
summary: Nintendo releases version 1.2.0 of the SNES classic on Switch Online with fixes and improvements.
